main.description: Builds an ordered feed skeleton from the same selection and cursor as app.gainforest.feed.getFeed. Each entry is only an AT-URI. A repost yields the repost record's URI. Entries follow the order of the items getFeed returns. A group yields the URI of every row it covers, newest first, listed together at the group's position, so a page can contain many more entries than its limit; a request consumes at most 5,000 rows. Authentication is optional and is verified when supplied; an invalid token is rejected, never treated as anonymous. The activity feed does not depend on the caller: the same request returns the same page whoever sends it, and omitting params selects the global feed. The following feed returns, in the same form, what the accounts a viewer follows have published; its viewer is the authenticated caller or, for an anonymous request, params.viewerDid. The caller hydrates returned AT-URIs separately.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request or the selected feed's parameters are malformed or semantically invalid.

errors.name: UnsupportedFeed
errors.description: The requested feed identifier is not registered by this service.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is invalid or incompatible with the selected feed.

errors.name: InternalError
errors.description: The service encountered an internal error.

feedId.description: Identifier of the feed algorithm to execute.

params.description: Algorithm-specific parameters. Optional for app.gainforest.feed.defs#activityFeed: when omitted, its default applies (filter all). For app.gainforest.feed.defs#followingFeed they are optional only on an authenticated request, which uses the caller as the viewer; an anonymous request must send followingFeedParams with a viewerDid.

limit.description: Number of cards to build the page from, as for app.gainforest.feed.getFeed. A group is one card but contributes every row it covers, so a page can contain many more entries than this number. The selected feed determines the default and may enforce a lower maximum.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous request for this feed.

schema.description: Returns ordered, unhydrated feed subjects and an optional cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted when no later page is known.

feedSkeletonItem.description: One unhydrated record selected for the feed.

subject.description: AT-URI of the record to hydrate.
